## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. > On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the Birch Path, discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept homestead of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), situated at the edge of their cleared land in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), reachable by a long, rose-bordered lane, and featuring an orchard-embowered house and a very neat yard.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +11 more_

**Associated with:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md)

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes a dressed-up [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in a buggy and visits Green Gables out of curiosity. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and concern over the risks of adoption before departing to spread the news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at Green Gables and admires the surrounding landscape from her window before being told by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to dress and come down for breakfast. After eating with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and a quiet [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) washes the dishes and names Marilla's geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return arrangements.

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to clarify the adoption mix-up, where Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. Seeing Anne's distress and disliking Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at Green Gables, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay with them, resolving to raise her properly.
